source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: University of Connecticut Family Nutrition Program, Senior Nutrition Awareness Project (SNAP) Newsletters

steps.instruction: Trim 2 cups of Brussels sprouts and cut them in half.
Steam the Brussels sprouts until tender.
steps.spoken: Steam them for about 6 to ten minutes, until tender. Or microwave on high for three to four minutes.

steps.instruction: Bring 1/2 cup of chicken broth to a boil in a non-stick pot.
Mix in 1 teaspoon lemon juice, 1 teaspoon mustard and 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme.
Boil until the broth is reduced by half.
steps.spoken: Boil about 5 to eight minutes, until the broth has reduced by half.

steps.instruction: Add the cooked Brussels sprouts to the sauce.
Toss well to coat with the sauce.
